title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the historic streets of Carlisle immediately surrounding Dickinson College, featuring local eateries, student housing, and cultural landmarks within walking distance.

cards.title: West High Street
cards.subtitle: 169 West High Street
cards.notes: Visit this student-run farm store for fresh produce and sustainable lunch options like seasonal soups and salads made with ingredients from the college farm.
cards.short_summary: A student-run farm-to-table cafe and grocery store on the main thoroughfare.
cards.evidence_claim: Farm Works is located at 169 West High Street and serves fresh food made with Dickinson College Farm produce.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Monday through Saturday during the academic year.

cards.title: West Pomfret Street
cards.subtitle: 16 West Pomfret Street
cards.notes: Browse handmade goods from over 40 local Pennsylvania artists and a large collection of Polish pottery in this colorful row of historic brick houses.
cards.short_summary: A quirky corridor of artisanal shops and boutiques in historic brick homes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Artist Market of Pomfret Street is located at 16 West Pomfret Street and showcases local craftsmen.
cards.source_title: Downtown Carlisle | Dining and Shopping - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Standard retail hours; located a few blocks southeast of campus.

cards.title: North Pitt Street
cards.subtitle: 21 North Pitt Street
cards.notes: Explore local history through museum exhibits and research archives located just one block from the college's eastern edge.
cards.short_summary: A historical museum and research center located on the edge of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cumberland County Historical Society is located at 21 North Pitt Street near Dickinson College.
cards.source_title: Cumberland County Historical Society - Visit Cumberland Valley
cards.access_notes: Museum admission is free; check website for research library hours.

cards.title: West Louther Street
cards.subtitle: 400 Block of West Louther Street
cards.notes: Walk past these upper-class student residences that define the northern boundary of the main academic quad.
cards.short_summary: A residential block housing upper-class students along the campus border.
cards.evidence_claim: The 400 & 500 blocks of West Louther Street contain Dickinson College student residences.
cards.source_title: 400 & 500 Block of West Louther Street | Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Residential street; building interiors restricted to residents.

cards.title: North Hanover Street
cards.subtitle: 37 North Hanover Street
cards.notes: Grab a burger or sandwich at this popular local grill located on the main north-south commercial corridor of downtown Carlisle.
cards.short_summary: A central commercial street featuring diverse dining and local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: North Hanover Grill is located at 37-39 N. Hanover St. and is a noted local eatery.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; under-21 safe dining area.

cards.title: South College Street
cards.subtitle: 101 South College Street
cards.notes: Visit this center for diversity and inclusion, which serves as a hub for student organizations and cultural programming.
cards.short_summary: A street bordering the campus featuring administrative and student life centers.
cards.evidence_claim: Landis House, located at 101 S. College Street, houses the Office of Diversity Initiatives.
cards.source_title: Physical Campus Address for GPS - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Open during standard university administrative hours.

cards.title: West North Street
cards.subtitle: 400 West North Street
cards.notes: Head to the northern edge of campus to find the Center for Sustainability Education and the Department of Public Safety.
cards.short_summary: The northern boundary street of the campus housing sustainability facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Kaufman Hall is located at 400 W. North Street and houses the Center for Sustainability Education.
cards.source_title: Physical Campus Address for GPS - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Academic building; public access to common areas during business hours.

cards.title: South Hanover Street
cards.subtitle: 35 South Hanover Street
cards.notes: Stop by this local bakery for fresh pastries and breads, located just south of the central square.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial street south of the town square with local food spots.
cards.evidence_claim: Carlisle Bakery is located at 35 S. Hanover St. and is a recommended local spot.
cards.access_notes: Open early morning through afternoon; check for daily specials.

cards.title: North College Street
cards.subtitle: 28 North College Street
cards.notes: Visit the campus store or grab a snack at the HUB, the central social and administrative building for students.
cards.short_summary: A key campus street housing the student union and administrative offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Holland Union Building (HUB) is located at 28 N. College Street.
cards.source_title: Physical Campus Address for GPS - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; late night hours for student study and dining.

cards.title: Mooreland Avenue
cards.subtitle: 99 Mooreland Avenue
cards.notes: Pass by this historic building on the western side of campus, which houses various academic and administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A residential and academic street on the western edge of the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Allison Hall is located at 99 Mooreland Ave. on the Dickinson College campus.
cards.source_title: Physical Campus Address for GPS - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Academic building; public access during business hours.
